name: 30350 · Atlanta, GA
findings: ZIP 30350 (Atlanta) has 144 nonprofit organizations. 59 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 47 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 30350 (Atlanta) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 18 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 27% of all organizations here have no identified type.
